walkthroughs.body_html:
Ethical Legal Cultural Issues — a core area of GCSE Computer Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Ethical Legal Cultural Issues brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Ethical Legal Cultural Issues.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which technique involves breaking a problem into smaller sub-problems?
options: Abstraction
Decomposition
Iteration
Encapsulation

mcqs.q: What is the purpose of a trace table?
options: To compile code
To track variable values during execution
To draw a flowchart
To store program output

mcqs.q: What happens when 11111111 + 1 is computed in an 8-bit register?
options: Encrypting data so it cannot be read.
Overflow - the result requires 9 bits but only 8 are available.
It just becomes 100000000 normally.
The computer crashes.

mcqs.q: What does inheritance allow a subclass to do?
options: Reuse and extend the attributes and methods of its superclass.
Replace the superclass entirely.
Copy code from any unrelated class.
The computer crashes.
The computer crashes.
Bundling data and methods together while restricting direct access to internal state.
Putting code inside other code (nesting).
Encrypting data so it cannot be read.
